blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-speech (TTS) is usually evaluated by transcribing its output with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system, so the word error rate also counts recognizer errors. We measure these errors on human recordings of the test sentences. On LibriSpeech and FLEURS, the evaluation recognizer misses 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech, and all three recognizers miss 22-42%. Checking every word with two more recognizer families lowers the apparent TTS error on words that at least one recognizer hears two- to three-fold (very rare LibriSpeech words: from 10-13% to 3-5%), yet very rare words remain the hardest. Ignoring words the recognizer misses in human speech is biased: the other recognizers find TTS errors far more often on these words (4-6% vs. 0.2-0.3%) and overturn about half of the errors this mask keeps. As half of the remaining adjudicated errors may be spelling variants, a listening test is needed.
blocks.zh: Text-to-speech(TTS)通常通过在自动语音识别(ASR)系统中转录其输出来评价,因此单词错误率也算作识别器错误. 我们用测试句的人类录音来测量这些错误。 在LibriSpeech和FLEURS上,评价识别器错过了33-67%的非常罕见的单词,即使是在人类的演讲中,三个识别器都错过了22-42%. 用另外两个识别家来检查每个单词会降低至少一个识别家听到2到3倍的单词上明显的TTS错误(非常罕见的LibriSpeech单词:从10-13%到3-5%),然而非常罕见的单词仍然是最难的. 忽略识别器在人类语音中忽略的词是偏颇的:其他识别器在这些词上发现TTS错误的频率要大得多(4–6%对0.2–0.3%),并且推翻了这个面具所保存的大约一半错误. 由于剩余的裁定错误中,有一半可能是拼写变体,因此需要一个监听测试.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The standard test of whether a text-to-speech (TTS) system says the right words is
the ASR round-trip : the synthetic speech is transcribed by a speech
recognizer, and the word error rate (WER) is computed against the input
text [ 1 , 4 ] . Recent systems also use the recognizer at
inference: they generate several candidates and keep the one it transcribes
best [ 15 , 2 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh:
文本对语音系统的标准测试是
ASR圆通:合成演讲由演讲转录
识别器,并且根据输入计算出单词出错率(WER)
文本 [1, 4] 。 最近的系统还使用在
推论:他们创造若干候选人,而保留他们所记录的人选。
[15,2,16]。

blocks.en:
This test measures two systems at once. If the recognizer cannot transcribe a word
even when a person says it, an error on this word tells us little about the TTS
system. Such words are mostly rare words, names and foreign words, which is exactly
where TTS errors are reported to concentrate.
blocks.zh:
这个测试同时测量出两个系统. 如果识别器无法转换一个词
即使有人这么说 这个词上的一个错误 也很少告诉我们TTS
系统。 此类词多为罕见的词,名和外语词,正是".
报告TTS错误集中之处。

blocks.en:
A recent study [ 2 ] calls rare words
“a genuine limit rather than a sampling problem”, but notes that it “did not
measure its false-positive floor on ground-truth audio”. We measure this floor. We use corpora in which every test sentence
has its original human recording, and we run the same recognizers on human and on
synthetic speech. The error on human speech is a diagnostic baseline, not a strict
bound, because synthetic speech can be easier or harder to recognize.
blocks.zh:
最近一项研究[2]称难得之词
“真正的限度,而不是取样问题”,但指出,它“没有,
在地面实况音频上测量其虚假阳性地层”。 我们测量这层楼。 我们用corpora,每个测试句
我们运行同样的识别器 在人和在
合成演说. 人类语言的错误是诊断基线,而不是严格的
被束缚,因为合成语言可以更容易或更难识别.

blocks.en:
We compare three estimates of TTS word error: the standard round-trip, a single-recognizer mask that ignores words the recognizer misses in human
speech, and a three-recognizer adjudication in which two more recognizers
check every word. Our main findings are: 1. The recognizer error depends strongly on word frequency. In human LibriSpeech
recordings it misses 1.5% of common but 32.9% of very rare
words. 2. Adjudication lowers the apparent TTS error two- to three-fold. Very rare words
remain the hardest, though about half of the remaining errors may be spelling
variants. 3. The single-recognizer mask is biased. It removes the words on which the other
recognizers find TTS errors most often, and they overturn half of those it keeps.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
ASR transcripts are widely used instead of listener transcripts to test TTS
intelligibility [ 12 ] , although ASR WER agrees only loosely with
listeners [ 13 ] . Yu and Kang [ 16 ] show that
best-of- N N results depend on the recognizer family used as judge. Luo and
Wan [ 7 ] report the opposite error to ours: a recognizer can hide
real TTS mistakes by writing what the text should say.
blocks.zh:
ASR 誊本被广泛使用,而不是用于测试 TTS 的听众誊本
虽然ASR WER只是松散地同意
听众 [13]. 余同康 [16] 示众.
最佳N成绩取决于作为法官的识别者家庭。 罗和
Wan [7] 向我们报告相反的错误:识别器可以隐藏
真正的TTS错误,写出文本应该说什么。

blocks.en:
The closest work is Appendix C of [ 14 ] (not in the ICML
version [ 13 ] ). It compares ASR WER with listener transcripts of
synthetic and human speech for one TTS system, at corpus level. We add the
dependence on word frequency, word-level checks with three recognizer families, and
their effect on rare-word results such as [ 2 ] , whose system we do
not re-run.
blocks.zh:
最近的作品是[14]的附录C(不在ICML中).
[13] 版 (中文(简体) ). 它把ASR WER和收听者录音记录
一个TTS系统的合成语和人语,在人体一级。 我们添加
依赖文字频率,与三个识别家庭进行文字级别检查,
它们对稀有词类结果的影响,例如[2],我们的系统
不重运行。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Word decisions
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 文字决定

blocks.en:
For each test sentence we have its text, the original human recording and N N synthetic versions. Three recognizers, A, B and C, transcribe all of them. C is the
evaluator (the verifier) whose round-trip we study; A and B are only used to check C.
blocks.zh:
对于每个测试句,我们都有它的文本,原始的人类录音和NN合成版本. 三个识别器,A,B和C, 全部转录. C为
A和B只用于检查C。

blocks.en:
Texts are normalized with the Whisper English text normalizer and aligned. A
reference word is recovered (the recognizer hears it) if it matches
exactly, or if up to three words differ from the transcript only in spaces
( any thing vs. anything ). We ignore insertions, so our rates are word
miss rates, not WER.
blocks.zh:
文本与Whisper英文文本规范化并一致。 A级
如果匹配, 引用词会被恢复( 识别者听到)
确切的说,或者说,如果只用空格就有三个字与笔录不同
(任何东西对任何东西)。 我们忽略插入,所以我们的费率是文字
误收率,不是WER。

blocks.en:
For recognizer X X , h X ​ ( w ) h_{X}(w) is true if X X hears word w w in the human recording,
and s X ​ ( w ) s_{X}(w) is true if X X hears w w in at least one of the N N synthetic versions.
Our rates are therefore any-of- N N rates, which fall as N N grows. We also report N = 1 N{=}1 and the one candidate that a best-of- N N system would keep.
blocks.zh:
对于识别器X X,h X (w) h_{X} (w) 如果X X听到人类录制中的 w w 字,则属实,
和 s X (w) s_{X} (w) 如果 X X 在至少一个N N 合成版本中听到 w w ,则为真.
因此,我国的税率是任何N-N比率,随着N-N的增长而下降。 我们还报告N=1 NQQ1,以及最佳N系统将保留的一个候选人。

blocks.en: 3.2 Three estimates of TTS error
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 TTS 错误的三种估计

blocks.en:
Word w w is a TTS error under (1) the standard round-trip if ¬ s C ​ ( w ) \neg s_{C}(w) , and under (2) the single-recognizer mask if h C ​ ( w ) ∧ ¬ s C ​ ( w ) h_{C}(w)\wedge\neg s_{C}(w) , that is, words
that C misses in human speech are ignored. Under (3) three-recognizer adjudication , err ⁡ ( w ) = [ h A ​ ( w ) ∨ h B ​ ( w ) ∨ h C ​ ( w ) ] ∧ ¬ [ s A ( w ) ∨ s B ( w ) ∨ s C ( w ) ] . \begin{split}\mathrm{err}(w)={}&\big[h_{A}(w)\lor h_{B}(w)\lor h_{C}(w)\big]\\
&\wedge\neg\big[s_{A}(w)\lor s_{B}(w)\lor s_{C}(w)\big].\end{split} (1) A word is judged if at least one recognizer hears it in the human recording.
Under (3), a judged word is an error only if no recognizer hears it in any synthetic
version. We report all three estimates per judged word.

The mask can fail in two ways. The ignored words may also be TTS errors, and an
error it keeps may still be a mistake of C. Adjudication reduces both problems but
does not remove them. It leaves out words that no recognizer hears, and a recognizer
may guess a word from context [ 7 ] ; both lower the error.
Spelling variants and shared recognizer failures raise it.

口罩可以从两个方面失效. 被忽略的单词也可能是 TTS 错误和
它所保持的错误可能仍然是C的错误。
不删除它们。 它留下了没有识别者听到的言语 和一个识别者
可能从上下文 [7] 中猜出一个词; 两者都降低出错。
拼写变体和共享识别器故障会提高.

blocks.en: 3.3 Word frequency
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 文字频率

blocks.en:
We measure word frequency with the wordfreq library [ 11 ] on the Zipf
scale, where z = 3 z{=}3 means once per million words. Very rare words have z < 2.5 z{<}2.5 and common words z ≥ 4.5 z{\geq}4.5 . Tokens with digits are not assigned to a band.

The LibriSpeech sentences were selected with a simpler corpus measure: a word is rare if it

blocks.en: 5.1 ASR errors on human speech
blocks.zh: 5.1 人类言论的ASR错误

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows that the recognizer error on human speech grows quickly
as words get rarer. C misses 1.5% of common LibriSpeech words but
32.9% of very rare ones (3.2% and 66.7% on FLEURS). On LibriSpeech, A and B also miss 31.8% and 30.3% of them.
blocks.zh:
表2显示人类语音的识别器误差迅速增加
因为言语越来越少 C 错过了普通 LibriSpeech 词的1.5%, 但是
32.9%的非常罕见的(FLEURS为3.2%和66.7%). 在LibriSpeech上,A和B也忽略了其中的31.8%和30.3%.

blocks.en:

of the audio, although A or B may also guess a word from context. The rest may be
unclear audio, dialect spellings that all recognizers normalize ( hisself → \to himself ) or shared blind spots.

虽然A或B也可能从上下文中猜出一个单词。 剩下的或许是
不清楚的音效,方言拼写,所有识别者都能够正常化(他自己~\\自己)或共享盲点.

blocks.en:
By definition the adjudicated error cannot exceed the standard error, so the size of
the gap is the result. Part of it comes from pooling, because an adjudicated error
must survive 3 ​ N 3N transcripts instead of N N .
blocks.zh:
根据定义,判定的错误不能超过标准错误,所以大小
差距是结果。 一部分来自集合,因为一个判定错误
必须活下来 3 N 3N记录誊本而不是N N.

blocks.en:
The gap remains for a single candidate
and for the candidate a best-of- N N system would keep. For the latter the ratio is 1.9 1.9 [ 1.5 1.5 , 2.4 2.4 ] and 2.5 2.5 [ 2.0 2.0 , 3.4 3.4 ] ( 2.1 2.1 [ 1.6 1.6 , 3.2 3.2 ] on FLEURS); this is
conservative, as the selection also removes some of C’s own errors.

Rare words remain the hardest. On very rare LibriSpeech words, the adjudicated error
is 3.4% for F5-TTS (10 of 298) and 4.7% for Kokoro (14 of 298), against
0 of 7,889 and 3 of 7,889 common words (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
很少的言语仍然是最难的。 在非常罕见的 LibriSpeech 词上, 裁定错误
F5-TTS为3.4%(298人中有10人),Kokoro为4.7%(298人中有14人),相比之下,
7,889个同名词中的0个和7,889个同名词中的3个(表2.).

blocks.en:
Part of this evidence is weak. 4 of the 10 and 5 of
the 14 very rare errors fall on the 32 words that only one
recognizer hears in the human recording. On the words that all three hear, each
system has errors on 3 of 215 words, mostly spelling variants
(Sec. 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
这一证据的一部分是薄弱的。 联合国
14个非常罕见的错误 落在32个字上 只有一个
识别器在人类的录音中听到。 三个都听到的词
系统在215个字中的3个有错误,大多是拼写变体
(第5.3节).

blocks.en:
The error also rises with the share of rare words in a sentence
(Fig. 1 , Table 3 ). The adjudicated trend is significant for
Kokoro with the corpus measure and for both systems with the Zipf share. With the corpus measure, it does not differ significantly from the standard trend ( + 0.063 +0.063 [ − 0.010 -0.010 , + 0.145 +0.145 ] and + 0.032 +0.032 [ − 0.045 -0.045 , + 0.107 +0.107 ]).
blocks.zh:
错误也随着句子中稀有词的比重而上升
(图1,表3). 所裁定的趋势对
Kokoro有保有量,对于两个系统都有Zipf份额。 采用体积计量法,与标准趋势(+0.063+0.063[−0.010-0.010,+0.145+0.145]和+0.032+0.032[−0.045-0.045,+0.107+0.107])没有显著差异.

blocks.en: 5.3 What the remaining errors are
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 剩下的错误是什么

blocks.en:
There are 23, 23 and 18 adjudicated errors in the three sets,
mostly names, archaic or foreign words and, on FLEURS, abbreviations.
blocks.zh:
这三组有23、23和18个裁定错误,
大多是名字,古老或外语的单词,在FLEURS上还有缩写.

blocks.en:
In 15, 8 and 12 cases the recognizer transcripts point to a different
pronunciation, for example Phoebe as “fuby” or BCE as “beasts”.
The other 8, 15 and 6 are spelling variants or homophones
( Bessy / Bessie , buoy / boy ) or text artifacts.
No transcript-based metric can tell these apart from mispronunciations.
blocks.zh:
在15起、8起和12起案件中,识别器记录笔录表明,
发音,例如菲比为"fuby"或BCE为"野兽".
其他8个,15个和6个是拼音变体或同音.
(贝西/贝西,浮标/男孩)或文字文物.
除发音错误外,没有任何基于记录的衡量标准能分辨这些.

blocks.en:
Counting only the first group, the TTS error is 1.7%, 1.7% and
5.7% on very rare words and 0.15%, 0.08% and 0.30%
overall, so rare words are still the hardest.
blocks.zh:
仅计算第一组, TTS 错误为 1.7%, 1.7% 和
5.7%在非常罕见的词上,0.15%,0.08%和0.30%
总的来说,如此罕见的文字仍然是最难的.

blocks.en:
Table 4: Test of the single-recognizer mask with A and B as judges, counting only
words that A or B hears in human speech. Left: TTS error on words that C misses or
hears there. Right: share of the mask’s kept errors that A or B hears in a synthetic
version. Values in % with 95% CIs.
blocks.zh:
表4:A和B作为法官的单一识别口罩测试,仅计在内
A或B在人类的演讲中听到的话 左: C 漏取的单词的 TTS 错误
听见了 右: A 或 B 在合成器中听到的口罩保留错误的比例
版本。 数值以%为单位,95%为CI.

blocks.en: 5.4 The single-recognizer mask is biased
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 单识别面具有偏见

blocks.en:
Table 4 uses A and B as judges. On the words that C misses in human
speech, they find a TTS error in 3.9% (F5-TTS) and 4.9% (Kokoro) of
cases, but only in 0.2% of the words that C hears. The mask thus removes the words that TTS gets wrong most
often, by more than an order of magnitude.
blocks.zh:
表4以A和B为法官。 在C想念的人的言语上
他们发现一个TTS错误:3.9%(F5-TTS)和4.9%(Kokoro)
C只听到0.2%的单词 面具因此删除 TTS 最错误的词
通常, 数量级以上。

blocks.en:
The mask also keeps false errors. Of its kept errors on words that A or B hears in
human speech, A or B hears 16 of 30 (F5-TTS) and 23 of
36 (Kokoro) in a synthetic version, so adjudication overturns about half.
Words that C misses are also hard for A and B, who both hear only 30% of them
in human speech (against 99% of the words C hears), so part of the contrast
may be shared difficulty.
blocks.zh:
口罩也存在错误. 在A或B听到的文字上 留下的错误
人类言论,A或B 听到30分中的16分(F5-TTS)和23分(23分)
36 (Kokoro)在合成版本中,因此判决推翻了大约一半.
C失手的话对A和B来说也是很难听的,他们都只听30%
在人类的言论中(相对于99%的C字),所以部分对比
可能有共同的困难。

blocks.en:
Computing the mask only over the words C hears (94–96% of words) changes
its rate by less than 0.03 0.03 points, so the denominator does not drive Table 3 .
With the corpus measure, neither the mask’s trend nor the difference between the
adjudicated and the mask trend ( + 0.037 +0.037 [ − 0.034 -0.034 , + 0.108 +0.108 ] and + 0.068 +0.068 [ − 0.017 -0.017 , + 0.154 +0.154 ]) is significant, so we claim
only that the mask is biased.
blocks.zh:
仅用 C 听到的字( 字数的94- 96%) 计算口罩的变化
其速率低于0.03 0.03分,因此分母不驱动表 3 。
既无面具的趋势,也无区别
因此,我们索赔的是:
只是面具有偏见

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
We first planned to adapt N N to each sentence and to stop when C hears all words of
a candidate. With this rule, 66–75% of the sentences (recordings on
FLEURS) are accepted by the second candidate. Of the sentences never accepted,
69–80% contain a word that C misses in the human recording
and in all N N versions, so C cannot tell whether TTS or C is at fault.
blocks.zh:
我们最初计划让NN适应每个句子 并且当C听到所有的话
a 候选人。 根据这一规则,66-75%的判刑(记录如下:
FLEURS)被第二个候选人所接受. 在从未接受的判决中,
69-80%包含C在人类录音中遗漏的词
而在所有NN版本中,C无法分辨TTS还是C是错.

blocks.en:
Our results suggest four practices for round-trip evaluation: (i) report the
recognizer error on the human recordings, by word frequency; (ii) do not simply drop
the words that the recognizer misses there; (iii) check disputed rare words with
other recognizer families or, better, with listeners; (iv) report N = 1 N{=}1 next to
any-of- N N .
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,有四种做法可以进行往返评价:(一) 报告:
按文字频率分列的人类录音中识别器出错;(二) 不简单地下降
(三) 检查有争议的稀有字词与
(四) 报告N=1 NQQ1旁边
任何N -N -N -N -N -N -N

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
No listening test. All TTS-error decisions come from recognizers, which
share blind spots. A listening test on these 23+23+18 errors, a sample of removed
errors and control words has been prepared but not yet run.
blocks.zh:
没有听力测试。 所有TTS-错误的决定来自识别器,
共享盲点。 23+23+18错误的监听测试,取出样本
错误和控制单词已经编写但尚未运行 。

blocks.en:
Few errors. With 23, 23 and 18 adjudicated errors, the
rare-word estimates and trends have wide intervals.
blocks.zh:
少出错. 有23、23和18个裁定错误,
稀有词的估计和趋势间隔很广。

blocks.en:
Scope. We use English read speech from two corpora. B and C were trained on
LibriSpeech, and C is both evaluator and judge.
blocks.zh:
范围。 我们用两只蝎子的英语演讲 B和C接受了培训
LibriSpeech和C既是评估者又是法官。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
An ASR round-trip scores the recognizer as well as the TTS system, and the
recognizer’s own errors are concentrated on rare words. With three recognizers on
human and synthetic speech, the apparent TTS error on judged words is two to three
times the adjudicated error, very rare words remain the hardest, and ignoring words
one recognizer misses is a biased correction that discards true errors and keeps
false ones. A listening test is needed to confirm
these results. We will release code, sentence lists and all transcripts.
blocks.zh:
ASR的回转计分法以及TTS系统
承认者自己的错误集中在罕见的词上。 三个识别器打开
人语和合成语 判词上明显的TTS错误是2到3
极罕见的词句仍然是最难的 并且忽略了词句
一个识别器缺失是一个偏差的更正,它会丢弃真实错误并保存
虚假的 需要监听测试来确认
这些结果。 我们将发布代码,句子列表和所有记录。
